discoveredDuringGate.summary: Browser benchmarks used fixed localhost ports and could fail or measure a stale preview.
discoveredDuringGate.reproduction: Leave another listener on 127.0.0.1:4173, then run pnpm qa:benchmarks; the renderer preview fails to become ready.
discoveredDuringGate.originalFailure: Preview did not become ready: http://127.0.0.1:4173
discoveredDuringGate.resolution: Production benchmark previews now use an OS-assigned localhost port and close the Vite server directly.
